verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HumanLayer can open draft PRs, let users navigate a PR changes tree, and let human reviewers comment on synced task documents. Nothing documents automatic AI review of every pull request with inline comments. `humanlayer automation run` from a CI job is only a building block a developer could use to construct such a reviewer, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments
